title: I to IV in F major
trains: From the home chord (I) to the chord on the fourth note (IV) with the least movement: the thumb keeps the keynote and the other two notes move up a step (fingers 4 and 5), so IV stands on its fifth (in C: C stays, E to F, G to A: F/C). The left hand holds the keynote.
